details: Bitcoin climbed over 20% since Wednesday, surging past $75,000 and briefly touching $79,400, marking its strongest weekly advance since March 2023. This rally is attributed to President Trump's call for the CLARITY Act to foster cryptocurrency use and the US Treasury's expanded sovereign bond buybacks, which have boosted investor risk appetite. Significant daily net inflows into Bitcoin ETFs have also contributed to the upward momentum.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $75,000 on US Policy Hopes & Treasury Action

details: Ethereum (ETH) saw gains of over 4%, reaching $2,327, while XRP surged approximately 15% intraday, as part of a broader altcoin rally. These movements are supported by sustained capital inflows into Ethereum ETFs, with daily net inflows reaching around $189 million on August 19. Additionally, Ripple is actively building institutional credit infrastructure on the XRP Ledger in collaboration with Clearpool and Cicada Partners, further fueling interest in XRP.
title: Ethereum and XRP See Strong Gains Amid Broader Crypto Rally
